learnings.question: In 1971, which economist and political scientist stated that in an information-rich world, what information consumes is the attention of its recipients?
learnings.learning: In 1971, Herbert Simon warned that in an information-rich world, the attention of recipients becomes the scarce resource that information consumes.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: Beyond muting low-value accounts, what personal habit is recommended as a way to protect your attention before opening any app?
learnings.learning: Protecting your attention isn't just about muting noisy accounts — it also means setting an appropriate intention before opening any app, so you decide what you consume instead of letting algorithms decide for you.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: A 19th-century researcher famous for studying memory proved that people forget roughly what percentage of newly learned material within just 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus showed in the 1880s that we forget about 80% of what we learn within 24 hours unless we actively force ourselves to recall it — which is why re-reading notes doesn't work as well as being quizzed on them.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: What term, coined by researchers studying the 'Google Effect', describes the modern tendency to forget information instantly because we know a device will store it for us?
learnings.learning: Researchers behind the 'Google Effect' paper coined the term 'Digital Amnesia' for the way our brains treat writing something down, or storing it on a device, as permission to forget it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact is used to visualize a sprint's progress and show how much work remains?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, the Burndown Chart is the artifact that visualizes a sprint's progress by showing how much work remains, helping the team track whether they're on schedule.

learnings.question: Which of the following is notably absent from the three official roles defined in the Scrum framework?
learnings.learning: Scrum defines exactly three roles — Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Developers — with no 'Project Manager' role at all.

learnings.question: What Arabic term describes humanity's role as caretakers or stewards of the Earth, entrusted with preserving faith and unity?
learnings.learning: Khalifah is the Arabic term for humanity's role as caretakers of the Earth, carrying responsibility for preserving faith and fostering unity within the community.

learnings.question: One framing of life's purpose centers on three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and a third role. What is it?
options: Living life as a test of faith and conduct, preparing for the Hereafter
learnings.learning: One framing of life's purpose in Islam centers on three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and living life as a test of faith and conduct in preparation for the Hereafter.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state leaves a device almost completely powered down, giving it the greatest power savings but the longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: In PCIe power management, the L2 state leaves a device almost completely powered down — it delivers the greatest power savings but takes the longest to wake up, unlike the lighter L0s and L1 substates.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term describes the actual unfolding of events in a person's life — shaped by their own actions and decisions, and able to be influenced through sincere prayer?
learnings.learning: Qada' is the actual unfolding of events in a person's life, shaped by their decisions and actions, and it can be influenced through sincere Dua — unlike Qadr, which is Allah's complete, already-written plan.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which Quranic principle is invoked to argue that personal transformation must come before a change in one's outward circumstances?
options: Allah helps those who help themselves
To every soul its own burden
Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra'd (13:11) — 'Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves' — is cited as the basis for believing personal change precedes a change in one's circumstances.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: When the Quran's Arabic text was analyzed word-by-word, what share of the entire text did the top 20 most frequent words account for?
learnings.learning: When the Quran's Arabic text was analyzed word-by-word, the top 20 most frequent words accounted for only about 20.83% of the whole text — far short of the 80% the Pareto Principle would predict.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: What term refers to the small diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds?
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are the small diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to show vowel sounds; without them, the same spelling can be read multiple ways.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Reflecting on his own list of 'unfair advantages' — a stable, practising Muslim upbringing, older siblings, and an international-school childhood — a software engineer named one specific trait as the one he actually relies on day to day, built from constantly moving between places and schools. What is it?
learnings.learning: Reflecting on his own 'unfair advantages' — a stable, practising Muslim upbringing, older siblings, and an international-school childhood — the author says the one he actually uses is empathy, built from constantly moving between places and schools.

learnings.question: After two years of biology in high school and just a few months into matriculation college, an entrepreneur walked away from a pre-medicine path and enrolled in Computer Engineering at which Malaysian university instead?
learnings.learning: After two years of biology in high school and a few months into matriculation college, the author walked away from a pre-medicine path and enrolled in Computer Engineering at Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP) instead.
